Bafel Talabani, head of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), who has traveled to Tehran at the head of a high-ranking delegation for consultations with senior Iranian officials, met and held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi before noon on Tuesday. During the meeting, Araghchi referred to the very good and constructive relations between the Islamic Republic of Iran and the government and people of Iraq and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, stressing the extensive potential existing in the border areas of the two countries. He described the outlook for relations between Iran and Iraq, particularly with the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, as bright and promising. Araghchi also stressed the Islamic Republic of Iran’s readiness to strengthen and expand relations with the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, particularly Sulaymaniyah, with a focus on expanding economic and trade exchanges, enhancing security coordination along the shared borders, and combating terrorism. Referring to some terrorist activities along the shared borders and attempts by enemies to exploit the situation, Araghchi stressed the need to strengthen cooperation to safeguard the security of the shared borders in accordance with the bilateral security understanding, stressing: “Our Kurdish friends and all countries of the region must remain vigilant against false-flag tactics designed to create divisions among neighbors.” The PUK leader, for his part, expressed pleasure at visiting Tehran and meeting with the Iranian foreign minister, referring to the historic, brotherly and friendly relations between the peoples of Iran and Iraq and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, and expressing appreciation for the Islamic Republic of Iran’s continued support for the Iraqi government and people. Talabani described Iran as the strongest and longstanding supporter of the Iraqi people, adding: “We take pride in our relations and friendship with the Islamic Republic of Iran, and are committed to comprehensively strengthening cooperation and relations in various fields, particularly political, security, economic and trade affairs.” Talabani also stressed the need for synergy between Iran and Iraq to implement the bilateral security agreement and disarm terrorist groups that undermine the security of the two countries, stressing: “Iraq and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq will never allow the territory of this country to become a haven for harming or threatening the security of regional countries, particularly the Islamic Republic of Iran.”

item.title: Iranian Foreign Minister Lebanese Parliament Speaker discuss regional developments by phone
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi held a telephone conversation with Nabih Berri, Speaker of the Lebanese Parliament, on Monday night. During the phone call, the two sides discussed regional developments and the need to strengthen coordination among regional countries to counter the hegemonic ambitions and warmongering of the Zionist regime against Lebanon and other countries in the region. The Iranian foreign minister, referring to Iran’s longstanding commitment to preserving Lebanon’s national sovereignty and territorial integrity in the face of attacks by the genocidal Israeli regime, stressed the Islamic Republic of Iran’s full support for Lebanon’s dignified resistance against the occupation and aggression of the Zionist regime. The Lebanese parliament speaker, for his part, expressed appreciation to the Islamic Republic of Iran for its support for Lebanon and provided a report on the current situation in southern Lebanon. Referring to the Zionist regime’s crimes against Lebanon, Berri underscored the legal and moral responsibility of the international community and Islamic countries to stop the lawlessness of the occupying regime and hold the perpetrators accountable and punish them.

item.title: Iraqi Kurdistan Patriotic Union chief to visit Tehran Tuesday
item.description: Esmail Baghaei, Spokesperson for the Iranian Foreign Ministry, told reporters that Bafel Talabani, president of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), will visit Tehran on Tuesday. According to the Foreign Ministry Spokesperson, Talabani’s visit, which is being made at the invitation of Iran’s Foreign Minister, is taking place within the framework of the Islamic Republic of Iran’s ongoing consultations with the Iraqi government and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq aimed at expanding bilateral relations and strengthening peace and stability in the region. The Foreign Ministry Spokesperson said that during the visit, the president of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan will hold talks and exchange views with senior Iranian officials on issues of mutual interest, including matters related to economic cooperation and border security.

item.title: Iran Iraq FMs discuss bilateral ties regional developments
item.description: Seyed Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, and Fuad Hussein, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Iraq, held a telephone conversation in which they discussed and exchanged views on bilateral issues, regional developments, and current trends. The two ministers, referring to the most important issues in Iran-Iraq relations, emphasized the state of stability and security along the shared borders of the two countries and the necessity of continued coordination. The two sides also, stressing the need to adopt responsible approaches toward regional developments, underscored the importance of preventing the escalation of tensions and the expansion of the scope of conflicts in the region.

Esmail Baghaei, Spokesman for the Iranian Foreign Ministry, during a visit to Lamerd County, paid tribute to the martyrs of the US and Israeli regime’s attacks. Baghaei visited areas of the county that were damaged and subjected to missile strikes, stressing the need to explain the dimensions of the crime committed against the Iranian people, and announcing that the attacks would be documented and legally pursued through international forums and institutions. Upon his arrival in Lamerd County, Baghaei was welcomed by local officials and a number of county managers. He then visited the Lamerd Martyrs’ Cemetery, where he paid tribute to the high status of the martyrs of the military aggression by the United States and the Israeli regime. The Foreign Ministry Spokesman also met with the family of Dr. Hamid Amini, a national scientific figure who was martyred in the US-Israeli military aggression. He stressed the need to present to the world the crime committed against the Iranian people on February 28 and called for its dimensions to be introduced to international public opinion. Referring to Martyr Amini’s scientific and national standing, Baghaei told his family: “Your martyr belongs to Lamerd, Fars and Iran.” The Foreign Ministry Spokesman then visited some residential areas and a sports hall that were targeted in the crime committed by the criminal US and Israeli regimes on February 28, and observed firsthand the damage and traces left behind by the attacks. At a press conference held at the Lamerd sports stadium in the presence of a number of domestic and foreign media journalists, Baghaei, referring to the martyrdom of 21 Lamerd residents in the US-Israeli military aggression, stressed the importance of documenting and recounting the human dimensions of the incident and said: “Each and every one of the Lamerd martyrs is dear and cherished by the Iranian nation, and their blood will not be in vain.” He described the targeting of civilians and residential areas as an explicit violation of the rules and norms of international law, stressing that the dimensions of these attacks must be explained to the Iranian and global public opinion accurately, with documentation and based on facts. The Foreign Ministry Spokesman added: “What happened in Lamerd is not merely a local incident; rather, it is a clear example of the consequences of military attacks against civilian areas and ordinary people, and it is necessary for the dimensions of this crime to be properly recounted to international public opinion.” Emphasizing that documenting the incident, collecting evidence, recording the damage and documenting accounts related to the victims are necessary requirements for pursuing the issue, he said: “These documents can be used in the process of raising the issue before international forums and institutions and for examining the responsibility of those who carried out the attacks.” He also announced that the legal case concerning the US attack on Lamerd would be pursued through international forums, stressing that the diplomatic apparatus of the Islamic Republic of Iran would seriously pursue, using all available means, the demand for justice and the accountability and punishment of those who ordered and carried out the crime in Lamerd. The Foreign Ministry Spokesman, stressing the need to prevent distortion of the facts related to these attacks, said: “Accurately recounting what happened to the people of Lamerd and documenting the testimonies and traces of this crime are part of the responsibility of the diplomatic apparatus to inform world public opinion about the human dimensions of attacks against civilians.”

item.title: Top Iranian diplomat congratulates new Kazakh Foreign Minister
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, in a message, warmly congratulated Mukhtar Tileuberdi on his appointment as the new Foreign Minister of Kazakhstan and wished him success and distinction in this important position. Part of the Foreign Minister’s message to his Kazakh counterpart reads: “The relations between the Islamic Republic of Iran and the Republic of Kazakhstan have always been based on mutual trust and respect and common interests, and the two countries have diverse capacities for expanding cooperation in the economic, political and cultural fields. I am confident that, given Your Excellency’s valuable and precious experience in the field of foreign policy, relations between the two countries will be further developed, and bilateral cooperation will move forward toward consolidating the long-standing ties and enhancing the level of relations. Taking this opportunity, I wish Your Excellency good health and success.”
